_note: Strings for omi_linking.py (the pairing window) and omi_link_tier.py (the spoken ask). Cues are regexes over the lowercased utterance with ?!.,;: dropped and a leading 'hey zoe' / politeness stripped; they must match the WHOLE utterance. A cue only ROUTES a turn. 'notice' is the one plain sentence a member hears the first time they link; keep legal wording out of it.
strip_lead: (?:can you|could you|please|would you|will you|can i|could i|i want to|i'd like to|i would like to|let's|lets)[\s]+

link: (?:link|connect|pair|set up|setup|add|register) my (?:omi|pendant|omi pendant|new pendant|new omi)(?: to (?:you|zoe|me|my account))?(?: please)?
this is my (?:omi|pendant)(?: link it| please link it)?

say.notice: Just so you know, your pendant records the people around you as well as you, and you can pause its syncing any time in Settings under My pendant.
say.start: Okay. Hold your pendant right next to the panel for a moment.
say.start_with_notice: {notice} Now hold your pendant right next to the panel for a moment.
say.screen_hold: Hold your pendant right next to the panel
say.linked: Done. Your pendant is linked to you, and it will sync whenever it's near the panel.
say.linked_not_remembered: Your pendant is linked to you, but the panel couldn't hold on to it just now. Keep it close and say link my pendant again.
say.already: That pendant is already linked to you.
say.crowded: I can hear more than one pendant here. Keep only yours next to the panel.
say.taken: That pendant is linked to someone else. They need to unlink it first, or the household admin can move it.
say.not_found: I couldn't find your pendant next to the panel. Make sure it's switched on, hold it close, and ask me again.
say.claim_failed: I found your pendant but couldn't link it just now. Please ask me again.
say.unverified: I'm not sure who's asking, so I can't link a pendant. Sign in with your PIN first and ask me again.
say.guest: Only someone who lives here can link a pendant, and only to themselves.
say.child: A grown-up in the house links a child's pendant in Settings.
say.no_panel: I can only link a pendant at the panel, with it in your hand.
say.panel_offline: The panel's Bluetooth isn't answering just now, so I can't link a pendant. Try again in a minute.
say.panel_busy: Someone else is linking a pendant at this panel right now. Try again in a minute.
say.off_sync_off: Pendant syncing isn't turned on here yet. Ask the household admin to turn it on.
say.off_linking_off: Pendant linking isn't turned on here yet. Ask the household admin to turn on pendant linking.
say.off_bluetooth_off: The panel's Bluetooth controls aren't turned on yet. Ask the household admin to turn them on.
say.status_none: You don't have a pendant linked yet. Say link my pendant with it in your hand at the panel.
say.status_linked: Yes, your pendant is linked to you.
say.status_linked_synced: Yes, your pendant is linked to you. It last synced {ago}.
say.status_paused: Your pendant is linked to you, but you've paused its syncing in Settings.
say.unlink_none: You don't have a pendant linked.
say.unlink_many: You have more than one pendant linked. Unlink the right one in Settings under My pendant.
say.unlink_done: Done. Your pendant is unlinked. Anything still on it will go to whoever links it next, so let it finish syncing first next time.
say.unlink_done_warn: Done. Your pendant is unlinked. If anything was still on it that hadn't synced, it will go to whoever links it next.
say.unlink_pending: Your pendant still has recordings that haven't synced. If you unlink it now, they will go to whoever links it next. Say unlink it anyway to do it, or leave it near the panel until they finish.
say.unlink_fail: Something went wrong and I couldn't unlink your pendant just now. Please ask me again.
say.unlink_forced: Done. Your pendant is unlinked. The recordings that hadn't synced will go to whoever links it next.
say.unlink_force_none: There's nothing to confirm. Ask me to unlink your pendant first.
